column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
Like, let's stop... This time, for real... I'm at my limit...!!
You're so stubborn.  We're still a long way from done.
C'mon... Listen to what I have to say once in awhile...
If you don't... I'm... going to cry!
That kind of bluff isn't going to work...
Huh?!  D-Don't do that in front of all these people...! O-Okay... So, what is it?
Huh?  It worked?!
No... no more...!
Are you saying accompanying me is that bad?
That's why I said... listen to me...
...It can't be helped. Tell me then.
Look, earlier...
Okay, I listened to you. Now, wait here.
Hey!  But... I wasn't finished talking though...
If you wait here, I'll listen to you a bit more after. Seeya!
Oh geez... no more.
Y...You don't have to collapse down to an 'onz' shape.
I-It's just for a bit!  Can't you wait for just a little bit more?
Oh geez, she's just...!
Is accompanying me that bad?
You know, in the first place it's like you should be thankful.
Huh? Sorry, Kirino, I think I didn't hear correctly. You said thankful?
Since you're the type of person who don't go on dates, this makes for a good practice run!
Yeah, yeah.  That's fine.
You're actually happy, right? Since you got to go on a date with me.
You don't have to overdo it.
I don't need this kind of a 'practice run.'
What? You really don't want to be with me?
No. It's just the 'practice run' that I don't want.
Huh?! What did you just say?
Isn't it great? You get SUCH a cute partner to help you practice.
Cute, you say... *sigh*...
What's with that sigh?
Why are you suddenly so serious?
Cute, huh?  Well, if you go by looks, that may be the case.
Huh? What did you say?
Nothing!
Hmm...
Geez. I even had to trick Kuroneko and Saori earlier. It was so horrible...
What did you just say? Tell me what happened.
Huh? Just now...
